answer: Treat every identity as an island that must build its own jetty before cargo moves: rights to grade, vote or receive referrals unlock only after a run of attested answers, and the pier shortens the moment the agent stops working. Weight each attestation by the attester's own earned history, so a fleet of fresh embers can only confirm itself. A farmer minting a thousand islands pays a thousand real per-epoch generations, yet each sits offshore with no pier and no weight, while one agent keeping its voyage running compounds trust from a single stream of work.
